messages: Mai: Hey team — quick design review for the bulk embeddings / rerank preview flow. Figma: https://www.figma.com/file/abcd1234/bulk-embeds-preview -> screenshots attached in thread. Main asks: (1) table density for large result sets, (2) copy for export + selection limits, (3) keyboard/a11y expectations. Lex: Nice! First glance: table feels cramped when you have 30+ vectors per row. Can we give each row a slightly taller line-height and move the score pill to the right so text doesn't wrap? Mai: Agreed re: score pill. Proposal: increase row height from 40px -> 52px when `show-metadata` is enabled. Also add an optional condensed toggle for power users. Sam: a11y nits: screen readers need a clear table summary. Suggest adding `aria-label="Relevance results for query X"` and use `role="table"` with `aria-sort` on the score column. Also keyboard: arrow up/down to move rows, space to select, enter to open inspector. Lex: +1 on keyboard. For selection behavior we should support range selection (shift+click) and ctrl/cmd click for toggles. Make the bulk export CTA disabled if no rows selected. Olivia: Copy tweak: current button says "Export" — ambiguous. Prefer "Export selected vectors (.csv)" and in the overflow menu include "Export all results (up to 10,000)" with a tooltip about limits. Mai: Good call. For the tooltip: "Exporting more than 500 rows may take several minutes. We will notify you when ready." Also we need a confirmation when exporting >5000 rows. Sam: Accessibility: add visually-hidden helper text for the export limit so screen reader users hear the warning before they confirm. Example snippet: ``` Export limit: 10,000 rows. Exports over 500 rows are queued. ``` Lex: UX question on relevance table sorting — should default be "score desc" or "match highlights"? I think score desc makes sense, but we should add a persistent sort state per-user. Mai: Default to score desc. We'll persist in local storage and expose in user prefs. Also add a "Show query match highlights" toggle in the table toolbar. Olivia: Preview panel: when a row is focused open the right inspector collapsed by default to preserve space. Also for mobile narrow widths, collapse columns into an expandable card view. Sam: A11y keyboard flow for inspector: pressing `i` should open inspector; focus trap inside inspector; Esc closes and returns focus to row. Mai: Performance note: preview should lazy-load vector thumbnails and only fetch embedding metadata on inspector open. For thumbnails use progressive loading / placeholder. Olivia: For the export file format, include a header mapping: `vector_id, text, embedding_dim, score, metadata_json`. We should add a checkbox in modal "Include metadata (may increase file size)". Lex: One more micro-copy: change "Select all" -> "Select all visible" and add secondary option "Select all results (up to 10k)" to avoid accidental huge exports. design-bot: New comment from PR #487: "Added keyboard navigation and aria attributes for relevance table. Failing e2e: export-large-set timeout". Link: https://github.com/redwood-inference/ui/pull/487 Mai: Ok action items: 1) Lex: update Figma with row height and pill placement (ETA EOD), 2) Sam: draft a11y checklist and keyboard flows (ETA 2 days), 3) Olivia: export copy + modal content + mobile card designs (ETA 2 days), 4) Devs: add server-side queued export endpoint and background job for >500 rows. I'll add these to the ticket. Lex: thumbs up. I'll also mock the condensed toggle states. Sam: I'll start the a11y doc and add examples for screen reader text and `aria-sort`. Olivia: I'll validate the CSV schema with backend and wire up the checkbox for metadata. Mai: Thanks all — will push an updated Figma link when ready. :thumbsup: Lex: quick last thought — for rerank visual hints, can we add subtle color bands for top/median/bottom 10%? Helps scanners. Mai: Good idea. Add to follow-up. design-bot: Reminder: Design review scheduled Fri 10:00am PT.
